title: Data-driven discovery of chemical reaction networks
summary: We propose a unified framework that allows for the full mechanistic reconstruction of chemical reaction networks (CRNs) from concentration data. The framework utilizes an integral formulation of the differential equations governing the chemical reactions, followed by an automatic procedure to recover admissible mass-action mechanisms from the equations. We provide theoretical justification for the use of integral formulations using analytical and numerical error bounds.
